info.title: EMR PT Layar Nusantara Gas - Backend API
info.description:
Enterprise Electronic Medical Record & Occupational Health Backend API.

Features:
- 12 Functional Feature Modules
- Medical Data Firewall (Permenkes 24/2022 & UU PDP 27/2022)
- FEFO Pharmacy Inventory & Locking
- Forensic Drug & Alcohol Chain of Custody
- Dynamic Clinical Calculation Engine (BMI, JNC-8, Audio STS, ASCVD)
- Whitelisted 15-Field MCU Gateway for Gate Turnstiles
- Edge Offline Resilience (48h offline operability)
